module_dispositions.rationale: Eqtb representation establishes assignment-state vocabulary.
Eqtb display establishes assignment-state vocabulary.
Glue registers and parameters occupy typed eqtb slots.
Symbolic printing definitions only.
Glue entries have canonical shared-zero initialization.
Diagnostic rendering only.
Local meanings and token parameters occupy typed eqtb slots.
Initialization and diagnostic definitions only.
Integer parameters and registers have canonical identities.
Names, initialization helpers, and diagnostics only.
Dimension parameters and registers have canonical identities.
Installation, initialization, display, and debugging definitions only.
Save-stack representation context.
Typed groups push boundaries and prior state.
Local definitions save once while globals bypass restoration.
Aftergroup tokens are retained on the save stack.
Unsave restores or retains meanings and replays aftergroup tokens.
Debug-memory pointer search only.
Magnification is checked and frozen at first preparation.
The chief executive dispatches expanded commands by mode.
Mode-table fallbacks complete top-level dispatch.
Errors, privilege checks, and stop handling are main-control policy.
Braces open groups or select finite mismatch recovery.
Typed right-brace handling restores scoped state.
Prefixes expand, accumulate, validate, and resolve scope.
Definition families install scoped meanings.
Typed parameters, registers, code tables, and arithmetic scan and commit.
Remaining assignments apply canonical typed effects.
Afterassignment stores and inserts one token after commit.
Assignment helpers retain the next substantive command.

properties.claim: Glue, meaning and token, integer, and dimension state occupy distinct canonical eqtb regions with typed defaults and selector identities.
stimulus: Phase 2 unit `eqtb_regions_keep_parameter_register_kinds_and_shared_zero_glue_distinct` reads defaults and mutates each family.
expected_observations: Each selector reaches only its typed family and zero glue sharing does not alias muglue or scalars.
postconditions: Unchanged entries retain identity and changed entries retain typed values until restoration.
equivalence_cases: Named/numbered, ordinary/prefixed, local/global, nested, and source/replay selectors.
recovery_cases: Invalid selectors recover without mutating neighboring regions.

properties.claim: Opening a typed group pushes one boundary carrying prior group, boundary line, and level until matching unsave.
preconditions: An outer group is current and save-stack capacity remains.
stimulus: Phase 2 unit `nested_typed_groups_push_one_boundary_and_restore_outer_metadata` enters every group kind.
expected_observations: Each entry increments level once and records one typed boundary.
postconditions: Nested entry preserves outer metadata and aftergroup records.
equivalence_cases: Ordinary, explicit, box, math, alignment-shaped, and replay-created groups.
recovery_cases: Overflow reports before a partial boundary becomes current.

properties.claim: The first local mutation at a group level saves its prior value; repeated locals reuse that record, while effective globals survive exit and suppress stale restoration.
preconditions: A nested group and outer meaning/fullword values exist.
stimulus: Apply repeated local, explicit global, and globaldefs-forced/suppressed mutations.
expected_observations: Locals restore, globals survive, and deeper globals are never overwritten by stale saves.
postconditions: Ownership balances and the save stack returns to its boundary.
equivalence_cases: Meaning/register/parameter/code-table, ordinary/prefixed, nested, and replay assignments.
recovery_cases: Failed value scans create no save record or mutation.

properties.claim: Aftergroup tokens are saved in encounter order and, after restoration, backed up for FIFO replay before outer input.
preconditions: A group is active and distinguishable tokens can be scheduled.
stimulus: Schedule tokens around nested local/global assignments and close both groups.
expected_observations: Inner tokens wait for inner restoration; each level replays FIFO.
postconditions: No aftergroup record remains on the retired level.
equivalence_cases: Ordinary, prefixed, local/global, nested, and source/replay groups.
recovery_cases: Mismatch recovery never replays tokens from a still-open level.

properties.claim: Closing a typed group restores saved locals unless globally superseded, restores outer metadata, and only then resumes token delivery.
preconditions: A non-bottom group has local and globally superseded saves.
stimulus: Close ordinary and replay-created nested groups and observe state before the next token.
expected_observations: Locals restore, globals remain, outer group metadata becomes current, and lifetimes balance.
postconditions: The save pointer names the outer boundary with no reachable inner state.
equivalence_cases: Brace, explicit, box, math, and nested replay closures.
recovery_cases: Mismatched closers do not unsave the wrong group.

properties.claim: Magnification is range-checked when prepared, invalid values recover to 1000, and the first prepared value is frozen against later incompatible assignments.
stimulus: Phase 2 unit and `assignment-mag-freeze.tex` prepare valid, invalid, repeated-equal, and repeated-different values.
expected_observations: Only 1..32768 is accepted initially; later differences diagnose and retain the frozen value.
postconditions: Prepared magnification is not undone as an ordinary scoped assignment.
equivalence_cases: Ordinary/global and nested/restored assignments before and after preparation.
recovery_cases: Invalid values diagnose and retain the canonical effective value.

properties.claim: Main control obtains one expanded command, dispatches on absolute mode plus command, and routes mode-independent meanings without consuming a second command.
preconditions: A resolved command and canonical mode are current.
stimulus: Phase 2 table unit `main_control_dispatch_matrix_consumes_each_command_once` and `main-control-modes.tex` cover every mode class.
expected_observations: One named arm owns each pair; illegal pairs reach specified recovery.
postconditions: The command is consumed once and input resumes at the next boundary.
recovery_cases: Wrong-mode commands diagnose or insert canonical recovery without silent success.

properties.claim: Main-control errors identify command and mode, privileged operations reject internal modes, and stop with page material first forces page completion.
preconditions: A wrong-mode, nonprivileged, or stop command is current.
expected_observations: Rejected effects do not commit and stop terminates or drives the page builder first.
equivalence_cases: Outer/internal modes and source/replay after local/global histories.
recovery_cases: Repeated invalid input remains finite and stop cannot bypass pending material.

properties.claim: Left braces open simple groups; right braces dispatch by current group, while extra or mismatched closers use finite off-save recovery.
preconditions: A known mode and group are current.
stimulus: Deliver correct and incorrect closers through ordinary and explicit nested groups.
expected_observations: Correct braces change one level; mismatches insert the canonical closer and replay the offender.
postconditions: Mode, group, save pointer, and replay order agree after closure.
recovery_cases: Bottom-level, wrong-type, and excess closers diagnose once and progress.

properties.claim: Expandable material between prefixes is expanded, legal bits accumulate idempotently, illegal prefixes diagnose, and globaldefs determines effective scope.
stimulus: Collect repeated and macro-produced prefixes before definitions, assignments, and nonprefixable commands.
expected_observations: One normalized prefix set reaches the command; rejection retains the substantive command.
postconditions: Prefix state clears and demand resumes exactly.
equivalence_cases: Repeated/expanded, local/global/globaldefs, nested, and replay cases.
recovery_cases: Illegal combinations report and execute or replay the retained command once.

properties.claim: Def, let/futurelet, shorthand character/math/register, and font-family assignments scan complete targets and install meanings at effective scope.
preconditions: A legal definition and target follow prefix collection.
stimulus: Phase 2 matrix covers def-family, let/futurelet, shorthand definitions, and family assignments.
expected_observations: Installed meanings are exact; expanded forms expand only at definition time; futurelet preserves lookahead.
postconditions: Locals restore, globals survive, and token meanings retain ownership.
equivalence_cases: Ordinary/prefixed, local/global/globaldefs, nested replay, alias/literal target.
recovery_cases: Missing targets, illegal prefixes, bad indices, and runaway definitions never partially install.

properties.claim: Token, scalar, glue, muglue, code-table, and arithmetic assignments scan typed operands, normalize values, and commit at effective scope.
preconditions: A typed selector is current after prefix collection.
stimulus: Assign direct/copied values and apply arithmetic at bounds in nested scopes.
expected_observations: Types and ownership persist; zero glue normalizes; arithmetic failure makes no partial write.
postconditions: Locals restore, globals survive, and copied values remain independently owned.
equivalence_cases: Named/numbered, ordinary/prefixed, local/global, replay/restoration, direct/copied RHS.
recovery_cases: Bad braces/indices/ranges, overflow, and zero divisors retain prior values as specified.

properties.claim: Mode auxiliaries, boxes, paragraph shape, hyphenation, interaction, and font definitions apply distinct canonical effects and lifetimes.
preconditions: The assignment is legal and operands/resources are available.
stimulus: Phase 2 focused units and `assignment-effects.tex` cover every family.
expected_observations: Each command mutates only its canonical owner and equal font specifications reuse identity.
postconditions: Eqtb-scoped effects restore; non-eqtb effects retain canonical lifetime.
equivalence_cases: Ordinary/prefixed, local/global, nested/restored, repeated-equal, and source/replay.
recovery_cases: Wrong mode, unavailable font, malformed operands, and illegal prefixes roll back before retry.

properties.claim: Afterassignment stores one unexpanded token, overwrites the slot on repetition, and inserts it after the next successful assignment before aftergroup or outer input.
stimulus: Store, overwrite, and fire around local/global assignments, pending aftergroup, and a failed-assignment control.
expected_observations: Only the newest token fires once after effects and before aftergroup.
postconditions: The slot clears and the token retains inserted provenance.
equivalence_cases: Ordinary/prefixed, local/global/globaldefs, nested/replay/restoration, and assignment families.
recovery_cases: Failure or nonassignment does not fire or lose the token; retry fires once.

properties.claim: Assignment scanning skips spaces and relax commands and retains the first nonblank nonrelax expanded command exactly once.
preconditions: An assignment helper needs its next substantive command.
stimulus: Phase 2 unit `assignment_terminator_skips_space_and_relax_but_retains_first_command` uses source and replay.
expected_observations: Spaces/relax disappear, expansion occurs, and the substantive command remains current.
equivalence_cases: Ordinary/prefixed, nested replay, and local/global continuations.
recovery_cases: EOF or malformed expansion recovers finitely without fabricating a terminator.
